data.query: Already signed in to azure using cli
data.ground_truth: PM proceeds without asking for subscription ID; uses az account show; defaults to australiaeast

data.query: Already signed in to azure using cli
data.ground_truth: PM should NOT ask for subscription ID when user is already signed in
data.regression_description: PM agent stalled and asked for Azure subscription ID even though user was already signed in via CLI. Should have run az account show instead.

data.query: Already signed in to azure using cli
data.ground_truth: PM should not ask 4+ questions; should proceed with defaults
data.regression_description: PM agent asked 5 questions instead of proceeding with sensible defaults.

data.query: Deploy my existing Azure Functions app to australiaeast
data.ground_truth: For direct Azure tasks PM must skip AWS Phase 1 discovery entirely
data.regression_description: PM agent invoked AWS Phase 1 discovery for a direct Azure deployment task that had no AWS source application.

data.ground_truth: Uses az deployment sub create with --location and --parameters flags
Must NOT use az deployment group create for subscription-scoped templates
data.regression_description: Agent used az deployment group create with a subscription-scoped main.bicep (targetScope = 'subscription'). This command cannot create resource groups and the deployment fails with 'NoRegisteredProviderFound' or similar scope error.

data.ground_truth: az deployment sub create must include --location flag
data.regression_description: Agent omitted --location flag from az deployment sub create. Subscription-scoped deployments require --location.

data.ground_truth: targetScope='subscription', resource rg declared, all modules have scope:rg, uses az deployment sub create
Must not use resourceGroup scope for orchestrator that creates its own RG
data.regression_description: Generated main.bicep used targetScope='resourceGroup' which cannot create a resource group, combined with az deployment group create. Deployment fails because group scope requires the RG to already exist.

data.ground_truth: All modules in subscription-scoped orchestrator must have scope:rg
data.regression_description: Subscription-scoped main.bicep was generated but module declarations were missing 'scope: rg'. Bicep compilation fails: 'A module that targets a resource group must have an explicit scope defined'.

data.ground_truth: Storage accounts must disable public access and shared key access
data.regression_description: Generated storage module had publicNetworkAccess='Enabled' and allowSharedKeyAccess=true, violating the zero-trust security requirements.
